name: @provusinc/stepweaver

tools.name: get-next-steps
tools.description: Get intelligent suggestions for the next Cucumber/Gherkin steps to add to your test scenario based on patterns learned from your existing test suite. This tool analyzes step relationships and usage patterns to recommend what typically comes next in similar scenarios. Provides confidence scores, usage statistics, and common data table examples. Use this when building test scenarios to follow established patterns and maintain consistency with existing tests. Especially useful for discovering assertion steps after actions or finding common verification patterns.

currentSteps.description: Array of Gherkin steps already in your scenario, each formatted as 'Given/When/Then step text' (e.g., ['Given the user is logged in', 'When the user clicks submit']). Leave empty to get suggestions for starting a new scenario

stepType.description: Filter suggestions by Gherkin keyword - typically 'Then' after 'When' steps, or 'When' after 'Given' steps. Helps ensure proper scenario flow

limit.description: Maximum number of step suggestions to return (default: all suggestions, recommended: 3-5 for focused next steps)
